items.text: I feel safe raising concerns in this team.
I hide my mistakes from others in this team to avoid blame.
I can ask questions in this team without feeling embarrassed.
I hesitate to disagree with others in this team because I fear their reactions.
I feel comfortable sharing unusual ideas in this team.
I worry that asking for help in this team will make others think less of me.
I feel comfortable admitting that I do not know something in this team.
